notes: Anthropic direct. Tiers resolve to model aliases. The fast tier remains unassigned until a bounded evaluation supports an assignment.

auditFallback.notes: For an audit that must retain its selected model, set this variable in the environment that launches Claude Code. The documented control disables automatic safety-classifier model switching for the session, including its subagents; it is not a per-role setting. A flagged request must be reported as refused, without an automatic retry on an older model. The interactive switchModelsOnFlag setting alone does not prevent subagent fallback. This records official documentation, not a live flagged-request probe, and no installed-version measurement. No environment or native settings are changed by this metadata.
